name: Dawnglade Regent — "as long as you're the monarch" reads its controller's Monarch toggle
notes: No condition branch knew 'you're the monarch', so the condition was dropped and permanents you control always had hexproof. A branch now reads the Monarch toggle of the source's controller (_gsOfController), and 'an opponent is the monarch' any opponent's. Player 2 is the monarch and controls Dawnglade Regent and Grizzly Bears; Player 1's tab is open and Player 1 controls Runeclaw Bear. Regent and Grizzly Bears have hexproof, Runeclaw Bear does not. Memory: project_monarch_initiative_conditions_2026-10-14.
